MEET THE ARTIST / 백예린

Yerin Baek

Yerin Baek is a singer-songwriter whose music spans R&B, pop and rock. Alongside her solo work, she helped form the rock band The Volunteers.

BY INDIEK / PUBLISHED 2026-10-19

Follow via RSS ↗

Baek debuted in the duo 15& in 2012 and released her first solo EP, FRANK, in 2015. Her album Our love is great won Album of the Year at the 2020 Korean Music Awards. The eighteen-track Every letter I sent you. came out in December 2019 and includes “0310” and “Square (2017)”.

R&B / POP / 2019

0310

Official lyric video

View release on Apple Music ↗

“0310” is sung in English, with the words on screen in Baek’s own lyric video. It’s from her 2019 album Every letter I sent you.

A little background

Baek describes the album as a collection of thoughts and memories from ages nineteen to twenty-three. “0310” has acoustic guitar, strings and a full band behind her voice. “Square (2017)” is on the same album if you’d like another song.

Written and composed by Yerin Baek. Arranged by Yerin Baek & Cloud.
